text:
maya: Heads up — quant bring-up (prod-candidate) tripped a regression on the golden wavefront sample. CI diff + manual spot checks show increased hallucination in long-code prompts :eyes:
noah: saw the CI alert, can you point to the failing eval split? long-code or convo?
rachel: long-code and instruction-following when >512 tokens. failure rate up ~8% on that slice (compared to float baseline).
jamie: labeler ops can do a micro relabel for a focused batch. how many items & which ids? we can prioritize as P0.
maya: initial batch = ~220 examples. quick list here: `100223,100224,100378,100412,100899,101201` (full list in eval artifact). s3://redwood-evals/bringup/1763609999/wavefront-report.html
ci-bot: CI: regression-check failed — delta 8.3% on golden-wavefront > threshold 5%. See: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9882 :warning:
noah: likely quant kernel issue for long context KV-cache handling. hypothesis: per-channel asymmetric q + 4bit outlier handling differs from float. can try `quant-config: perchannel-symm, outlier-clamp=1.5`
rachel: we should also expand the golden to cover these long-code patterns — current golden underrepresents multi-file/ctx-swap patterns. propose +300 synthetic anchors from repo-scrapes.
jamie: tagging a relabel job: `labeler-run --golden-wavefront --priority P0 --assign 6` — we'll need instructions for edge cases (what counts as hallucination vs partial missing code).
maya: I'll draft a short rubric then. quick list of failure types: 1) hallucinated functions not in prompt 2) truncated imports/ctx bleed 3) made-up API calls. will post rubric in this thread by EOD. :memo:
noah: while relabel runs, I'll run two quant variants on a 1k-sample perf harness: A) perchannel-symm int8 + clamp B) rowwise-gptq 4bit with KV-fix. compare perplexity + pass/fail on the 220 golden.
rachel: if B reduces hallucination but costs latency, we need a cost/latency tradeoff doc for product. can you capture p95 latency delta?
noah: yep, will attach microbench. aiming to complete runs in ~3h.
jamie: relabel job created (J-4821). Assigned to 6 labelers, ETA 12h. I'll add the rubric and edge examples. :thumbsup:
maya: added rubric + two annotated examples (in thread) and flagged the original authors for context. also added a small sampling script to surface similar candidates: ```python
# sample wavefront candidates
from redwood.data import sample_by_pattern
cands = sample_by_pattern(patterns=["multi-file", "ctx-swap", "long-imports"], n=300)
print([c.id for c in cands[:10]])
```
ci-bot: NOTE: blocking deploy flagged until regression closed or fallback configured.
noah: plan: run variants, if B (gptq4) reduces regression -> can consider fallback routing for long-code route to B; else iterate quant params. will report results here.
rachel: once relabel is done, we'll repro compute precision/recall on updated golden and decide whether to add those anchors permanently.
maya: thanks — I'll monitor labeler progress and sync with eng-sre for rollout guardrails. ping me if you want to triage any specific sample IDs. :wave:
